_comment: PROVENANCE MANIFEST. NInfer for Windows (Apache-2.0; Windows CUDA build of https://github.com/Neroued/ninfer) is never bundled: the main process downloads this one pinned release asset only after the user asks to install the NInfer runtime, verifies size_bytes and sha256 before extraction, checks the zip's own SHA256SUMS, and installs it under userData/engines/ninfer/<install_dirname>/. The download URL is derived from repo, release and asset (never read from this file) and redirects once to release-assets.githubusercontent.com. size_bytes and sha256 equal the GitHub release API digest field for v0.9.1, verified 2026-10-13 (24 zip entries under one top-level folder, 481.3 MB uncompressed, largest ninfer-serve.exe at 231236096 bytes). Jenny launches ninfer-serve.exe itself on loopback; the launcher scripts in the zip bind 0.0.0.0 with --cors --webui and are never used. No model weights are referenced here: the model artifact is pinned separately in ninfer-artifacts.json.
